description: Compute cash runway in months, cash buffer days, current ratio, quick ratio, debt to equity, DSO, DIO, DPO and cash conversion cycle from any subset of a business's own cash, monthly flow and balance sheet figures. Arithmetic only, no network. Each value carries its formula and the inputs it used; a value that cannot be computed is null with a reason.

annual_cogs.description: Cost of goods sold for the last twelve months.

annual_revenue.description: Revenue for the last twelve months.

cash.description: Cash on hand. Every figure uses the same currency unit. May be negative.
